<translate>
A '''Saiyan Crater''' is a crashed Saiyan pod with a Saiyan scout standing by it, somewhere on the land of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. Killing the scout starts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Assault|Saiyan Assault]] raid.
</translate>

<translate>
== Starting the raid ==
</translate>
{{Main|Saiyan Assault}}
<translate>
* When you come within 80 blocks of a crater, you get a chat warning: ''"Your scouter picks up a Saiyan pod that just crashed nearby..."''
* Each crater has one scout, shown with a supervillain aura. Killing it starts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Assault|Saiyan Assault]].
* A crater is spent once its scout dies or disappears.
</translate>

<translate>
See [[Special:MyLanguage/Raids|Raids]] for how a raid plays out.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding one ==
</translate>
<translate>
Saiyan Craters can generate anywhere on land, spread out and kept away from villages, but only in newly generated chunks. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate saiyan_crater}} to find the nearest one.
</translate>
